scope: crypto-autoresearcher; maintained program surfaces, not every archived experiment

skills.name: agent-bus
skills.description: Send, read and answer durable, write-once messages between agent sessions in separate chats, worktrees or runtimes. Use to tell another session something (a contract froze, a batch was reranked), to check mail on wake, or to connect or coordinate chats.

skills.name: audit-curve
skills.description: Rigorously audit a specified elliptic curve, its twist, and reachable isogenous representatives for conventional ECDLP, transfer, and implementation weaknesses. Use when asked whether a named or supplied curve is weak, safe, or vulnerable through an isogeny.

skills.name: audit-runs
skills.description: Audit finished runbook sessions on a schedule or on request: verify the journal chain and digests, replay nonce-sampled trials, recompute metrics and certificates, screen Lean statements; flags escalate to Opus. Use before an evidence review cites a runbook session. Never runs trials or changes research state.

skills.name: bench
skills.description: Assess benchmark receipts, cost models, throughput claims, rank/relation metrics, CPU/GPU comparisons and performance regressions. Use when asked whether a measured optimization is faster or comparisons are fair. Use run to collect trials and review-evidence to promote research claims.

skills.name: consolidate-lanes
skills.description: Carry pointers between agent-bus lanes that cannot see each other, so two sessions circling one experiment find out before the second spends budget. Use on a schedule while several sessions work one goal, before approving an overlapping batch, or to reconcile parallel sessions. Pointers only; changes no status.

skills.name: coordinate
skills.description: Coordinate the program: rank work, open batches, approve complete protocols, dispatch non-execution tasks, archive and publish. Use for /coordinate, portfolio coordination, or resuming a GOAL-* without running trials. Not an execution skill; /run launches experiments.

skills.name: curate-knowledge
skills.description: Add or update entries in the knowledge corpus (knowledge/): literature notes, technique references, established results, internal findings promoted from evidence, and open problems. Use when ingesting a paper, recording a known technique, or promoting a validated internal result.

skills.name: curve
skills.description: Inspect or maintain exact curve identities, EC1 aliases, curve UIDs, field metadata, trait catalogs and comparison imports. Use for catalog work and identity mismatches. Use endo for CM analysis, transfer for maps, and run for trials.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description: Read-only portfolio analysis (ledger, knowledge corpus, literature) that produces a ranked, justified shortlist of experiments to run next, dispatching idea-generator and the coordinator, with optional red-team. Use for what to work on next, a roadmap or priority ranking, or before a new campaign.

skills.name: design-experiment
skills.description: Convert a selected proposal (IDEA-*) into a specified hypothesis and a frozen, approved experiment contract ready for execution. Use after ideation, when the Coordinator selects ranked work. Runs under Coordinator authority.

skills.name: endo
skills.description: Assess endomorphism rings, CM discriminants, conductors, GLV/GLS decompositions, Frobenius or tau-adic structure, and scalar multiplication cost claims using existing endosweep artifacts. Use for endomorphism analysis and implementation planning, not a discrete-log attack campaign. Run requests use run.

skills.name: formal
skills.description: Inspect or maintain Lean theorem targets, formalization task specs, proof obligations, axiom audits and verification receipts. Use for formal proof work or a supplied theorem verification request. Existing formal task execution goes through run; official mathematical conclusions require review-evidence.

skills.name: gpu
skills.description: Inspect or improve CPU/CUDA arithmetic kernels, batched step throughput, GF(2) GPU updates, register/occupancy bottlenecks and GPU benchmark correctness. Use for kernel engineering and supplied GPU diagnostics. Use ops for cloud resources and run for existing arithmetic or step trials.

skills.name: ic
skills.description: Inspect index-calculus artifacts: factor bases, relation quality, decomposition metrics, Frobenius phases and independent-rank accounting. Use for IC review or experiment design support on synthetic examples; use solver for linear algebra and run for trials.

skills.name: ops
skills.description: Inspect or maintain research runtime configuration, GPU/EC2/RunPod resources, DP storage infrastructure, backups, checkpoints, KB services and job synchronization. Use for infrastructure health, recovery or explicitly requested resource changes. Scientific experiment launches remain run.

skills.name: pr
skills.description: Prepare, update or review a scoped pull request, inspect CI/review status, synchronize branches and perform an explicitly authorized merge in crypto-autoresearcher. Use for code delivery and repository integrity work. Never add PR creation as an automatic phase of run.

skills.name: propose-ideas
skills.description: Generate structured, falsifiable research proposals for an ECDLP research question. Use when starting ideation for a research question (RQ-*) or when the Coordinator requests fresh directions. Dispatches the idea-generator subagent and files proposals in the ledger.

skills.name: research-status
skills.description: Summarize the current state of the research program: open questions, hypothesis statuses, experiments in flight, recent decisions, and next actions. Use at session start or whenever an overview of the ledger is needed. Read-only.

skills.name: research-visuals
skills.description: Produce evidence-linked diagrams, graphs, reports, and PDFs for every experiment run, every evidence review, and every substantive search for new isogenies, curves, scalar rules, endomorphisms, and related ECDLP mechanisms.

skills.name: review-evidence
skills.description: Review completed experiments, Lean theorem artifacts, or Lean proof workflows. Validate machine evidence and independent claim fidelity, record scoped findings, and preserve Coordinator authority over official scientific decisions.

skills.name: route
skills.description: Choose skills and tools when asked what to use, where a technique lives, or which binary implements it. Use for repo orientation and skill selection. Explicit experiment execution goes directly to run.

skills.name: run
skills.description: Run existing experiments and report their outputs. Use for run, run experiments, run the harness, or a named experiment, task, goal, or existing experiment command.

skills.name: scheme
skills.description: Assess proposed cryptographic schemes and their security games, reductions, distributions and honest-party algorithms. Use for EUF-CMA, SUF-CMA, IND-CPA/CCA, AKE or EndRing construction obligations and recipient-lift questions. Use design-experiment for a trial contract and formal for proof artifacts.

skills.name: solver
skills.description: Diagnose existing Groebner, SAT, Macaulay, GF(2), rank, certificate and solver-worker artifacts; check correctness and accounting. Use for solver-stage questions. Use ic for relation semantics, review-evidence for official conclusions, and run for trials.

skills.name: transfer
skills.description: Assess lifts, descents, field extensions, isogenies, curve covers and Jacobian correspondences: does moving the problem to another curve, field or Jacobian make it easier? Use to audit a supplied map, cover or descent claim, or claimed speedup. Produces certificates, cost accounting and open obligations.

skills.name: tune-skill
skills.description: Propose a reward-guided revision of another skill's instructions, using its downstream ledger records as the reward. Writes no ledger record; every diff is a code change a human approves. Use to tune or improve a skill against its track record, e.g. `/tune-skill propose-ideas`.

skills.name: ui
skills.description: Build or maintain the crypto-autoresearcher dashboard, curve traits, receipt comparisons, provenance views and static exports. Use for reader bugs, UI features, benchmark imports and local previews. Use curve for identities, bench for comparison meaning and pr for publishing changes.

skills.name: sheriff
skills.description: Deep integrity audit of research results across crypto-autoresearcher, crypto and cryptanalysis: execution proofs, Lean theorems, solve certificates, cost accounting against matched rho, statistics, provenance and paper numbers. Use for /sheriff, 'is this result real', or before a claim or benchmark row lands. Writes write-once cases; never repairs or changes research state.

skills.name: lead-atlas
skills.description: Review and maintain the ECDLP lead atlas (knowledge/leads/ecdlp/) - what this program has already tried against ECDLP across crypto-autoresearcher, crypto, cryptanalysis and ecc-challenges. Use at session start when the brief says something changed since the last review, before ideation, when asked whether an idea or lead has been done, or to bring the atlas to saturation (every record mapped, every lead dispositioned, nothing new since review).

skills.name: experiment-protocol
skills.description: Design, preregister and freeze an unbiased controlled experiment as an experiment.protocol/v1 record before any data is taken, in any of the owner's repositories: classify every claim, build reference, baseline, candidate, A/A, positive and negative control arms, write the variable ledger that isolates every confounder, fix randomization, seeds, blinding, sample size and power, precise counted metrics, the isolation level a clock needs, the queue and checkpoint policy, stopping and decision rules and a frozen analysis; then bind the run's unified experiment.export/v1 to it. Use whenever an experiment, benchmark, sweep, training run or measurement is about to be designed or launched, and before any comparative or statistical sentence is written.

skills.name: review-run
skills.description: Review another runner's experiment from its experiment.export/v1 bundle, without the producer's session, and file a write-once experiment.review/v1 record of checks, observations, per-claim judgments, open questions and a recommendation. Verifies hashes, protocol adherence, controls, a nonce-sampled replay where the backend admits one, a recompute of the headline numbers from the raw rows, statistics and scope. Use when asked to review, check, replicate or second-opinion a run, a benchmark or a sweep from any of the owner's repositories, before an evidence review or validation gate cites it, or on a schedule. Changes no research status and repairs nothing.

skills.name: research-kb
skills.description: Pointer to the canonical research-kb procedure owned by crypto. Use before prior-art, negative-result, open-problem, exact-theorem or cross-repository lead work, and before a subagent handoff. The full query recipes, field reading, receipt format and fallback are in crypto:.agents/skills/research-kb/SKILL.md; the shared rule is docs/lab-contract.md section 11.

execution_rule: run is the sole scientific execution skill; topic profiles add no preflight
